# Hassan Tahrioui | Lead Full-Stack Developer

> Freelance lead full-stack developer based in Morocco, working remotely on European hours. Builds and operates commercial web platforms end-to-end: frontend, backend, payments, integrations, deployment and production support. Available part-time for a limited number of freelance projects. Site available in English and French (/fr/).

Core stack: Next.js, React, Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, Laravel, PHP, Strapi, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, DigitalOcean, Docker, Nginx, Cloudflare, Stripe, Mollie, OpenAI, DeepSeek.

Currently leads development on VisitFootball, a live multilingual football ticketing and travel platform. Also builds his own SaaS products, including Tracefox (session replay, journey testing, checkout QA and UX monitoring for online stores).

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.tahrioui.me/services/): full-stack web and SaaS platforms, e-commerce and payments, APIs and automation, AI features, DevOps and production support, performance and technical SEO.
- Engagement models: fixed-scope projects, monthly retainers, and hourly consulting from $35/hr. Every engagement starts with a free intro call.
